name: goldband
description: Goldband portable Codex plugin with shared engineering skills and opt-in MCP configuration. Full Codex setup remains install.sh codex-full.

interface.shortDescription: Portable engineering skills and optional Goldband MCP readbacks for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Installs the portable Goldband skills for Codex app, CLI, and IDE extension. The plugin includes an opt-in MCP wrapper for a local goldband checkout, but does not replace install.sh codex-full or package Goldband Loop.
